title: Israeli Settlers Torch Fields and Fire on Homes in Turmus Ayya and Jalud
detail: Israeli settler extremists carried out coordinated arson and gunfire attacks overnight on two Palestinian West Bank villages. In Turmus Ayya, near Ramallah, settlers opened fire on homes on the town's outskirts and set fire to farmers' fields in an apparent attempt to terrorize residents. In Jalud, near Nablus, settlers burned chicken coops adjacent to a home that had been under near-daily settler harassment; the family was forced to abandon the property the next day. The IDF confirmed both attacks; no injuries were reported and no arrests were made. The same day, Israel's security cabinet approved 1.3 billion shekels ($426.3 million) to establish 34 new outposts/settlements, part of a broader wave described by rights groups as 'quiet annexation' of the West Bank.

media.caption: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian towns of Turmus Ayya and Jalud in the occupied West Bank — July 22, 2026
